source_institution: Office of the Economic Adviser, DPIIT, Government of India
transformations: Only official OEA observations are permitted.
Monthly index levels are converted to causal trailing growth/volatility features at model time.
No index observation dated after the PAIMANA snapshot may be joined.
Incompatible base-year index levels must not be concatenated without an official linking factor.
No lower-level steel or cement linking factor is invented when an official factor is unavailable.
known_limitations: The repository intentionally does not commit a hand-transcribed WPI table.
The experiment remains INS UFFICIENT VERIFIED EXTERNAL DATA until prepare_exp120_wpi.py is run against official OEA files and a reviewed compact wpi_monthly.csv is supplied.
OEA monthly files may be revised; checksums should be recorded by the preparation script for the exact retrieved files.
